rootSource:
name: CI

on:
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - develop
      - main
  push:
    branches:
      - develop
      - main
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: ci-${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
qualityHeader:
quality:
    name: Quality Gate
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
setupSteps:
- name: Check out repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v7

- name: Set up Java 17
        uses: actions/setup-java@v6
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: "17"
          cache: gradle
qualityRunSteps:
- name: Run quality gate
        run: ./gradlew --no-daemon --max-workers=2 -Dorg.gradle.jvmargs=-Xmx2g -Pkotlin.daemon.jvmargs=-Xmx2g ktlintCheck assemble test

- name: Verify production deployment policy
        run: node --test .github/scripts/deploy-workflow.test.cjs .github/scripts/deploy-guard-contract.test.cjs .github/scripts/deploy-extraction-contract.test.cjs

- name: Verify read-only production preflight contract
        run: node --test .github/scripts/production-preflight-contract.test.cjs

- name: Verify first transition and subsequent automatic release contract
        run: node --test .github/scripts/approved-release-pipeline.test.cjs .github/scripts/issue108-release-catalog.test.cjs .github/scripts/issue109-release-catalog.test.cjs .github/scripts/issue110-release-catalog.test.cjs .github/scripts/issue107-integrated-catalog.test.cjs .github/scripts/issue107-runtime-auth-catalog.test.cjs

- name: Verify exact review and account history release catalogs
        run: node --test .github/scripts/v19-review-release-catalog.test.cjs .github/scripts/v20-account-room-index-release-catalog.test.cjs .github/scripts/v21-input-evidence-release-catalog.test.cjs .github/scripts/v22-conditional-place-release-catalog.test.cjs

- name: Verify OAuth proxy log privacy
        run: node --test .github/scripts/issue110-nginx-privacy.test.cjs

- name: Verify production Compose secret fidelity
        run: bash deploy/scripts/verify-compose-secret-fidelity.sh

- name: Verify runtime provider key delivery
        run: node --test deploy/tests/runtime-provider-env.test.cjs

- name: Verify operator runtime delivery
        run: node --test deploy/tests/runtime-operations-env.test.cjs

- name: Verify auth runtime delivery and isolated key mounts
        run: node --test deploy/tests/runtime-auth-env.test.cjs deploy/tests/runtime-auth-compose.test.cjs deploy/tests/runtime-auth-raw-json.test.cjs

- name: Verify managed runtime policy and auth readiness metadata
        run: |
          node --test deploy/tests/issue131-runtime-bundle-env.test.cjs .github/scripts/issue131-policy-catalog.test.cjs
          python3 -m unittest discover -s deploy/tests -p 'test_issue131*.py' -v
          python3 -m unittest deploy.tests.test_issue144_production_ai_deployment -v

- name: Verify isolated built image workflow
        run: node --test deploy/tests/built-image-workflow.test.cjs

- name: Verify deployment completion and approved transition orchestration
        run: |
          node --test .github/scripts/issue154-pipeline-catalog.test.cjs
          python3 -m unittest discover -s deploy/tests -p 'test_issue154*.py' -v

- name: Verify database credential refresh
        run: bash deploy/tests/refresh-database-credential.test.sh

- name: Verify persistent V8 release guard
        run: python3 -m unittest discover -s deploy/tests -p 'test_v8_release_guard*.py' -v

- name: Verify executable artifacts and stopped maintenance resume
        run: python3 -m unittest discover -s deploy/tests -p 'test_issue141*.py' -v

- name: Verify production Nginx runtime
        run: bash deploy/scripts/verify-nginx-runtime.sh
arm64JobSource:
built-image:
    name: ARM64 Built Image
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    permissions:
      contents: read
    env:
      CI_SOURCE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
      CI_IMAGE_TAG: meet-me-ci:${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
      DOCKER_BUILD_RECORD_UPLOAD: "false"
      DOCKER_BUILD_SUMMARY: "false"
    steps:
      - name: Check out exact source
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          ref: ${{ env.CI_SOURCE_SHA }}
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Set up ARM64 emulation
        uses: docker/setup-qemu-action@v3
        with:
          platforms: arm64

      - name: Set up image builder
        uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v3

      - name: Build isolated ARM64 image
        uses: docker/build-push-action@v6
        with:
          context: .
          platforms: linux/arm64
          tags: ${{ env.CI_IMAGE_TAG }}
          load: true
          push: false
          provenance: false
          cache-from: type=gha,scope=arm64-verification
          cache-to: type=gha,scope=arm64-verification,mode=max

      - name: Verify packaged runtime
        run: bash deploy/scripts/verify-built-image.sh "$CI_IMAGE_TAG" > built-image-verification.json

      - name: Preserve sanitized image proof
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: built-image-verification
          path: built-image-verification.json
          retention-days: 3
          if-no-files-found: error
originalRunCommands:
node --test deploy/tests/issue131-runtime-bundle-env.test.cjs .github/scripts/issue131-policy-catalog.test.cjs
python3 -m unittest discover -s deploy/tests -p 'test_issue131*.py' -v
python3 -m unittest deploy.tests.test_issue144_production_ai_deployment -v
publicationRootSource:
name: Deploy Production

on:
  workflow_run:
    workflows: [CI]
    types: [completed]
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      action:
        description: Read metadata or deploy an existing published release
        type: choice
        options:
          - preflight
          - deploy
          - resume
          - reconcile
        default: preflight
        required: true
      build_run_id:
        description: Successful publication workflow run ID
        type: string
        required: true
      build_run_attempt:
        description: Exact publication attempt
        type: string
        default: "1"
        required: true
      approve_first_transition:
        description: Approve the reviewed first transition or stopped maintenance resume
        type: boolean
        default: false
      operation_id:
        description: Original operation SHA256 for read-only reconciliation
        type: string
        required: false

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: production-deploy
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
